title: Daughters of Utah Pioneers Museum

services.name: Docent Training Videos
services.desc: A new Daughters of Utah Pioneers year is just around the corner, and we've updated the Docent Information section of the McQuarrie Memorial Museum website to help you prepare for another wonderful year of serving our visitors. Whether you're a returning docent or serving for the first time, these resources are designed to make your museum assignments easier and keep you informed throughout the year. We encourage all docents, camp officers, and docent leaders to review these materials before your next scheduled service day. blurb: Explore pioneer history at the McQuarrie Memorial Pioneer Museum in St. George, Utah. Operated by the Daughters of Utah Pioneers, the museum offers free admission, diverse artifacts, and genealogical research opportunities.
